mapper.select: SELECT corp_id FROM wecom_corp_space WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wecom_corp_space (workspace_id, corp_id, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{corpId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wecom_corp_space WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND corp_id = #{corpId}
